artboards.title: Today — every card the same weight
Reranked — one focal object, direction everywhere

annotations.text:
BEFORE
Five cards, one material. The Action Center, the charts and Quick actions all read as equally important, so nothing is. No trend, no deltas, largest type tier unused, and brand red spent on decorative bullets.

AFTER
Three tiers of material. A today strip answers 'how is the business moving', the Action Center is the single focal object, and every counter carries direction. Red is spent on three things only: money, the primary action, and the 2px hairline marking that one focal object.
